```{python}
import pandas as pd
```

```{python}
# Create a dataset of basketball players
data = {
    "Player": ["John", "Mike", "Alex", "Chris", "David"],
    "Points_Per_Game": [18, 24, 15, 21, 27],
    "Rebounds_Per_Game": [5, 7, 4, 6, 8],
    "Assists_Per_Game": [6, 5, 8, 4, 7]
}
```

```{python}
# Create a Pandas DataFrame
players = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Display the data
players
```

```{python}
# Basic summary statistics
players.describe()
```

```{python}
# Find the player with the most points
top_scorer = players.loc[players["Points_Per_Game"].idxmax()]
# Display top scorer
top_scorer
```

```{python}
# Select players who score at least 20 points per game
high_scorers = players[players["Points_Per_Game"] >= 20]
# Display high scorer
high_scorers
```

```{python}
# Calculate the team's average points per game
players["Points_Per_Game"].mean()
```
